root_cause.text: The PHY LED trigger registration/deregistration was performed in phy_attach_direct/phy_detach which are always called under the rtnl_mutex, creating a circular lock dependency with the triggers_list_lock taken by the netdev LED trigger activation path.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message describes the deadlock: one path holds RTNL (via dev_ioctl) and then tries to acquire triggers_list_lock (via led_trigger_register), while another path holds triggers_list_lock (via led_trigger_write) and then tries to acquire RTNL (via register_netdevice_notifier). The patch resolves this by moving the phy_led_triggers_register/unregister calls to phy_probe and phy_remove, which do not hold RTNL.
